name: Temper Fist
description: Heat the qi in the fist, then strike one foe with it as hard as a bar fresh from the quench.

name: Quenched Skin
description: Cool the heated qi suddenly into the skin so it sets hard against a blow already on its way to the user.

name: Steel Wrist
description: Turn a stiffened wrist against the flat of a foe's blade and knock the stroke off its line.

name: Annealing Rest
description: Soften and ease the user's own cramped and torn muscles with slow warm qi, so strain from hard practice drains away.

name: Hard Stride
description: Plant each foot with a ringing weight and cover a long pace in a single stamp.

name: Steelfall
description: Bring the hardened fist down on one foe's guard from above with the weight of the whole body, driving through the guard.

name: Springcut
description: Cut with a blade tempered to flex like spring steel, so the edge bites the foe's weapon and throws it off line as it rebounds.

name: Light Chain
description: Swing a short chain of metal qi from the wrist and rap one foe across the knuckles.

name: Chain Wrap
description: Wind a chain of qi round the chest and back so a cut must break the links before it reaches the user.

name: Wire Snare
description: Lay a noose of wire qi across the line of a foe's step so the foot is caught and drawn tight.

name: Link Pull
description: Snag a foe's weapon with a hooked link and pull so the foe's balance is lost for a breath.

name: Wire Swing
description: Fix a line of wire qi to a beam or post and swing across a gap in one long arc.

name: Wire Feeling
description: Lay a slack wire of qi along the ground and feel through it the tread of anyone who steps near.

name: Chainbind
description: Wrap a foe's limbs and weapon in several turns of chain qi and keep the links drawn tight while the foe struggles.

name: Wirecut
description: Draw a taut thread of qi through a foe's guard and cloth, slicing what it crosses.

name: Shard Toss
description: Break a shard from a plate of metal qi and toss it at one foe's leg.

name: Splinter Dart
description: Snap a long metal splinter from the fingers so it flies straight at a single foe's hand or face.

name: Shard Veil
description: Hang a thin cloud of loose shards before the body to catch and turn small missiles.

name: Shard Gathering
description: Reach out through the metal affinity to feel where loose scraps lie nearby, and how many, ready to be drawn into hail.

name: Fragment Step
description: Kick off a shard thrown to the ground as a footing and skip aside from a charge.

name: Shard Edge
description: Hold a large shard in the fist like a knife and slash one foe's forearm with it.

name: Shardhail
description: Burst a plate of metal qi into a fan of shards that rake the foes standing close together before the user.

name: Splinterburst
description: Shatter a held bar of qi at arm's length so a tight ring of splinters flies out around the user at every foe in reach.

name: Shard Whirl
description: Keep a turning screen of shards whirling before the user to batter aside thrown blades and arrows.

name: Ring Mail
description: Grow a close coat of linked rings of metal qi over the torso, so a cut finds no gap.

name: Ring Cuff
description: Close a band of grown rings round each wrist to guard the hands against a blade drawn along the arm.

name: Link Collar
description: Raise a collar of linked rings about the neck and jaw to turn a stroke aimed at the throat.

name: Ring Throw
description: Slip a ring of grown mail from the wrist and fling it edge first at one foe.

name: Ring Knuckle
description: Close the fist in a set of grown rings and strike so the rings cut as well as bruise.

name: Link Reading
description: Touch a foe's mail with metal qi and read the make of its links and where they are weakest, for the user's own knowledge.

name: Ring Stride
description: Let the grown mail chime and lighten with each footfall so the user bounds a pace and a half further than usual.

name: Hauberkgrow
description: Feed ambient qi into the coat of rings over a whole exchange so each broken link is grown back as it falls.

name: Ring Flay
description: Whip a trailing string of grown rings from the arm across one foe so that the rings flay what they strike.

name: Linkshear
description: Gather rings into a spiked chain-point and drive it through a foe's own mail at one weak link.

name: Iron Pull
description: Drag at the iron on a foe's person so his belt, scabbard or buckler tugs him half a step off balance.

name: Steel Call
description: Call on a steel post across a gap and let its pull draw the user quickly across to it.

name: Bar Throw
description: Draw a short iron bar from the ground to the hand and hurl it at one foe.

name: Draw Guard
description: Pull a thrown iron missile aside with the metal affinity so that it misses the user.

name: Metal Scent
description: Taste the pull of every blade and fitting in a crowded room and tell which men are armed and with what.

name: Pull Strike
description: Draw one foe's armored breast toward an iron fist with a pull of qi, so the blow lands with doubled force.

name: Weapondrag
description: Wrench a foe's iron or steel weapon out of its line and out of the hand with one hard pull of the metal affinity.

name: Ironsurge
description: Drag a foe's armor down toward the iron under the ground and hold it there so the foe cannot rise.

name: Gong Fist
description: Hit one foe with a fist that sounds like a struck gong so the blow drives deep into the chest.

name: Gong Skin
description: Set the skin ringing at the moment of impact so the force of a blow spreads out and fades.

name: Low Toll
description: Sound one low note of metal qi and read from the echo how many living bodies and fittings are within the room.

name: Toll Shiver
description: Send a toll through a foe's guard so the arms tremble and the next stroke slips.

name: Gong Step
description: Stamp once so the ring of the stamp pushes the user back a pace out of reach.

name: Gongstrike
description: Strike the ground or a plate and let a sharp wave of ringing metal qi radiate out to shake every foe nearby.

name: Tollward
description: Wrap the body in a continuous slow ringing that breaks up the force of blows as they land.

name: Silver Bead
description: Flick a bead of liquid metal qi from the fingers so it strikes one foe and splashes cold on the skin.

name: Bead Slip
description: Run the body's qi like quicksilver so the user slides under a reaching arm and out the far side.

name: Quicksilver Guard
description: Let a stroke run off a skin of liquid metal as water runs off wax.

name: Liquid Skin
description: Hold a skin of liquid metal over the body that closes round a blade and swallows the force.

name: Silver Coat
description: Run a thin coat of liquid metal down an ally's blade so it cuts cleaner and sheds blood and rust.

name: Bead Reading
description: Roll a drop of liquid metal across a floor or plate to learn its slope and any hollow beneath, for the user.

name: Quickflow
description: Turn the whole body to flowing metal for a heartbeat and run through a narrow gap between two foes.

name: Silverrun
description: Send a ribbon of liquid metal from the hand that lashes round a foe's guard and whips at his eyes.

name: Mercurywrap
description: Pour liquid metal over a foe's weapon arm and let it set hard, binding the limb in a cold sleeve.

name: Silver Pin
description: Drive a pin of silver qi through a gap in a foe's guard and into the muscle behind it.

name: Silver Touch
description: Lay a cool silver hand on an ally's bruise or shallow wound and draw the swelling down and the edges together.

name: Silver Sight
description: Look at food, drink or a wound with silver qi and see the dark film that marks a poison or taint, for the user.

name: Bright Skin
description: Polish the skin to mirror brightness with silver qi so a cut slides off and a burning glare is turned back.

name: Silver Ring
description: Spin a ring of silver qi before the hand and knock aside a thrown blade or dart.

name: Pale Step
description: Move one pace on a cold, quick glide that leaves no sound and no mark of metal on the ground.

name: Silverpurge
description: Draw poison or taint out of an ally's blood through the skin and bind it into a pin of silver qi, which the user then casts away.

name: Silvermend
description: Pass cold silver qi through an ally's wound, knitting torn flesh and sealing bleeding while the user keeps the touch.
